Go away to college and get financial aid/loans. Make sure your mom doesn't claim you on her taxes since she is kicking you out. You can live at college dorm make great friends and then you won't have to fight the world right away. You will learn the ways of the great institutions and learn a skill, gain experience AND you can work on campus to make extra money.  When you get out of college you can get a job making enough money to pay for things and you won't have to beg and survive. That's what I did, I didn't have much growing up and my mom died before I could graduate. There was not a lot going on after graduation and being home didn't work out for me. I applied to a two year program because I wasn't sure if I would do well(actually I didn't get in for a long time because the dean was sitting on the application to decide. I went to the school 5 hours away and made a deal that I would do excellent my first semester(I was a very bad student in general) but I made them keep me there. Life is tough but you have to make tough decisions to get ahead in this life. Work hard and be rewarded for it. You never know what is waiting on the otherside. Good luck and congratulations.

items.title: Passed my audit! YES!
items.text:
Passed my audit! YES!
Step one done. OK, I just got the email from PMI that I passed the audit process. I don't have 500 dollars sign up to pass the test. Does anyone know how long I can wait to sign up? I think I will need a few weeks to clear my budget to start. I guess I can consider it leads and lags. :)
Ahh I thought that was after the signup. Ok. Thanks.
OK I logged in and saw the year eligibility.

Thanks! I failed the first audit because I was not aware about how to word your experience. PMI is very particular. I am glad because it reinforces the certification however It wasn't that specific of what they wanted to see. All good now! Never been so excited to take one of the hardest tests I will probably have to take. YAY.
Most companies will sort you in a maybe pike if they see you have a PMP. Most PMP positions require a PMP. Do you want the job?

I did a lot of searches about PMP experience descriptions. I found some good ones on edward designer, and youtube. Basically, you want to put in your objective, your role (project manager the whole time), and then break down your hours if you put in IN, PL, EX, MC,CL and use your pm processes. Finally you want to put the outcome. Be sure to use those abbreviations. There is not a lot of characters allowed. 550 only. Good luck.

Wow sounds like we have had the same experience. Very nerve racking. My PMI class didn't really go into this all that much at all so I didn't give it much thought the first time through. I thought it was a basic way to establish the certification account. Now we know.  How are you finishing up your last two weeks of studying. I have to come up with some extra cash for the test and then I can hunker down and focus on filling gaps and what not. I am between 75-85 on prepcast quizzes so i am going to start taking 150 question tests soon.

I love your tips, I find myself getting caught on the questions that ask for a tool or a process. That can probably alone save you from making a bad choice and help eliminate the bad choices. Very true.
Congratulations BTW! You are probably on cloud 9.

Are you doing it for your own reasons or is your workplace pushing you toward it? I don't underestimate the value of this PMI cert IMHO. I have a graduate degree in Project Management and for me it is the icing on the cake. It will definately help you have successful projects as at a minimum foster communication.

items.title: Alternatives to pet teeth cleaning
items.text:
Alternatives to pet teeth cleaning
I have heard some horror stories about dental cleanings and issues from putting your dog under anesthesia. Actally just this week we got news that a friend brought thier dog in for a cleaning and the pup had respiratory distress as a result. They told her to come and pick the dog up and bring it to the pet hospital. My dog seems to be very healthy bit she is allergic and sensitive to many different things. I would like to know what the alternatives are for getting my pups teeth cleaned. I have been using a finger brush but that doesn’t work anymore her teeth are relatively clean.

Congratulations! a lot of work has paid off for you. I am working toward passing the PMP myself. Have a great time. Take it all in. People watch, and take the time to relax. It is so much more worth it to do so vs being so busy you can't enjoy it!
